pytest_addhooks.summary: called at plugin registration time to allow adding new hooks via a call to ``pluginmanager.add_hookspecs(module_or_class, prefix)``.

pytest_addoption.summary: register argparse-style options and ini-style config values, called once at the beginning of a test run.

pytest_assertrepr_compare.summary: Return explanation for comparisons in failing assert expressions.

pytest_cmdline_main.summary: called for performing the main command line action. The default implementation will invoke the configure hooks and runtest_mainloop.

pytest_cmdline_parse.summary: return initialized config object, parsing the specified args.

pytest_cmdline_preparse.summary: (**Deprecated**) modify command line arguments before option parsing.

pytest_collect_directory.summary: Called before traversing a directory for collection files.

pytest_collect_file.summary: Return collection Node or None for the given path.

pytest_collection.summary: Perform the collection protocol for the given session.

pytest_collection_finish.summary: Called after collection has been performed and modified.

pytest_collection_modifyitems.summary: called after collection has been performed, may filter or re-order the items in-place.

pytest_configure.summary: Allows plugins and conftest files to perform initial configuration.

pytest_deselected.summary: Called for deselected test items, e.g. by keyword.

pytest_enter_pdb.summary: called upon pdb.set_trace(), can be used by plugins to take special action just before the python debugger enters in interactive mode.

pytest_exception_interact.summary: Called when an exception was raised which can potentially be interactively handled.

pytest_fixture_post_finalizer.summary: Called after fixture teardown, but before the cache is cleared, so the fixture result ``fixturedef.cached_result`` is still available (not ``None``).

pytest_generate_tests.summary: generate (multiple) parametrized calls to a test function.

pytest_ignore_collect.summary: Return True to prevent considering this path for collection.

pytest_itemcollected.summary: We just collected a test item.

pytest_leave_pdb.summary: called when leaving pdb (e.g. with continue after pdb.set_trace()).

pytest_load_initial_conftests.summary: implements the loading of initial conftest files ahead of command line option parsing.

pytest_make_parametrize_id.summary: Return a user-friendly string representation of the given ``val`` that will be used by @pytest.mark.parametrize calls. Return None if the hook doesn't know about ``val``. The parameter name is available as ``argname``, if required.

pytest_plugin_registered.summary: a new pytest plugin got registered.

pytest_pycollect_makeitem.summary: Return a custom item/collector for a Python object in a module, or None.

pytest_pycollect_makemodule.summary: Return a Module collector or None for the given path.

pytest_report_from_serializable.summary: Restores a report object previously serialized with pytest_report_to_serializable().

pytest_report_header.summary: return a string or list of strings to be displayed as header info for terminal reporting.

pytest_report_teststatus.summary: Return result-category, shortletter and verbose word for status reporting.

pytest_report_to_serializable.summary: Serializes the given report object into a data structure suitable for sending over the wire, e.g. converted to JSON.

pytest_runtest_call.summary: Called to run the test for test item (the call phase).

pytest_runtest_logfinish.summary: Called at the end of running the runtest protocol for a single item.

pytest_runtest_logreport.summary: Process the :py:class:`_pytest.reports.TestReport` produced for each of the setup, call and teardown runtest phases of an item.

pytest_runtest_logstart.summary: Called at the start of running the runtest protocol for a single item.

pytest_runtest_makereport.summary: Called to create a :py:class:`_pytest.reports.TestReport` for each of the setup, call and teardown runtest phases of a test item.

pytest_runtest_protocol.summary: Performs the runtest protocol for a single test item.

pytest_runtest_setup.summary: Called to perform the setup phase for a test item.

pytest_runtest_teardown.summary: Called to perform the teardown phase for a test item.

pytest_runtestloop.summary: Performs the main runtest loop (after collection finished).

pytest_sessionfinish.summary: Called after whole test run finished, right before returning the exit status to the system.

pytest_sessionstart.summary: Called after the ``Session`` object has been created and before performing collection and entering the run test loop.

pytest_terminal_summary.summary: Add a section to terminal summary reporting.

pytest_unconfigure.summary: Called before test process is exited.

pytest_warning_captured.summary: (**Deprecated**) Process a warning captured by the internal pytest warnings plugin.

pytest_warning_recorded.summary: Process a warning captured by the internal pytest warnings plugin.
